takeaway: Before I ask an agent to build anything, I write half a page saying who it's for, the tiny first version, a 'Done when' list I can check by tapping, what I'm not building, and when I'd quit. Otherwise the agent builds the average app full of decisions I never made.
intended: Shaping means deciding what to build, for whom, and how you'll know it worked before any code, so an agent doesn't decide for you.
